node.statement: For the same v_+, put delta_+:=C_ext e. Because the EXT-CB datum has e=delta+epsilon_{A_R} with nonnegative defects, epsilon_{A_R}<=e; hence 0<=delta_+ + epsilon_{A_R}<= (C_ext+1)e <= (C_ext+1)C_s2^0 e_2 <= e_iso_unit. Apply lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control with B=M_{r+1}, A=A_R, v=v_+ to obtain ||v_+(I_{M_{r+1}})-u_{A_R}|| <= C_iso_unit(delta_+ + epsilon_{A_R}) <= C_iso_unit(C_ext+1)C_s2^0 t <= D_2 t.
